0983cf8133.q: How does Grub Lab's augmented reality feature work for kids menus in restaurants?
0983cf8133.a: Grub Lab uses augmented reality where customers scan a QR code inside the kids menu to bring up interactive content. For example, they can scan to bring Benny the Bull to life, paint the character, add stickers, and spawn the character on the restaurant table. They also offer a Jurassic dinosaur experience that appears on the table, creating a wholesome wow factor that engages kids immediately.
